title: The Message Highway Inside You
intro: This quiz follows the journey of messages through the brain, spinal cord, and nerves inside the nervous system.

questions.prompt: What carries messages between the brain and the rest of the body?
questions.explanation: Nerves carry messages between the brain and the rest of the body.

questions.prompt: What is the main job of the brain in the nervous system?
choices: To control the body and process information
questions.explanation: The brain's main job is to control the body and process information.

questions.prompt: What does the spinal cord do?
choices: It carries messages between the brain and nerves throughout the body
questions.explanation: The spinal cord carries messages between the brain and nerves throughout the body.

questions.prompt: Why might a person pull their hand away quickly after touching something hot?
choices: The muscles make the decision without receiving a message
A quick reflex helps protect the body from injury
questions.explanation: A quick reflex helps protect the body from injury when something hot is touched.

questions.prompt: Which order correctly shows how the body may respond to touching something hot?
choices: Muscle moves → skin feels heat → nerve sends message
Skin senses heat → nerves send a message → body pulls away
Brain sleeps → bones move → skin cools
Heart pumps → lungs breathe → hand moves
questions.explanation: The skin senses heat, nerves send a message, and the body pulls away.
